name: arezaeinia-claude-plugins
description: A collection of Claude Code plugins focused on test architecture and code quality for Kotlin/Spring Boot services.

plugins.name: spring-boot-kotlin-test
plugins.description: Shapes the test architecture, framework conventions, and maintainability patterns for Kotlin/Spring Boot services. Applies the Practical Test Pyramid end-to-end: the right test type for each class, consistent structure across the codebase, and conventions that keep the suite easy to maintain as it grows.

plugins.name: spring-boot-java-test
plugins.description: Shapes the test architecture, framework conventions, and maintainability patterns for Java/Spring Boot services. Applies the Practical Test Pyramid end-to-end: the right test type for each class, consistent structure across the codebase, and conventions that keep the suite easy to maintain as it grows. Stack: Java 21, Spring Boot 3.4+, JUnit 5, Mockito, AssertJ, TestContainers.
